speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of your double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness, can you tell me if your symptoms started suddenly or gradually, and do they worsen with exercise?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The pattern of ptosis/double vision worsening with up/down gaze and significant fatigability of limb muscles that improves with rest is highly suggestive of Myasthenia Gravis. Have you noticed any difficulty swallowing or speaking? REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibody; REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_nerve_stimulation
